text_block_list.text:
Fans have piled into the stands to see
today's big
G1 race, the Asahi Hai F.S.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер is determined to prove
that she's
more than Марузенски's
"Successor," and will
reach the top
herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With this purpose in mind, she heads for
the
track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
